regions.text: 华三常“接昀俩然がある偶然性は有と無との境界線に危く立脚する極限的存在にほかならない。

quote.translation: Contingency, in which A is, although it is also possible for A not to be, is nothing other than a limit-existence that stands precariously on the boundary line between being and nothingness.

regions.text: 可能性は現賞性を有たない非現實であるが、必然性への動向を具備してゐる限り有の色彩の濃いものである。可能性は實に實在性の次元にあつて必然性と大小對當の開係に立つものである。

quote.translation: Possibility is the non-actual, lacking actuality, yet insofar as it is equipped with a tendency towards necessity it is deeply coloured by being; in the dimension of reality, that is, possibility stands with necessity in the relation of subalternation.

regions.text: それに反して、偶然性は現實性を有ちながら、不可能性に近接する限り無を満喫してるるものである。

quote.translation: Contingency, by contrast, has actuality, yet insofar as it lies close to impossibility it has its fill of nothingness, and in the dimension of nihility it stands with impossibility in the relation of subalternation.

regions.text: 圓を以て必然性と可能性をに共通の有の性格を表はすならば偶然性は不可能性の無が定またま有に接する切點に過ぎない三三四買冬照）。

quote.translation: If we represent by a circle the character of being that necessity and possibility share, contingency is no more than the point of tangency at which the nothingness of impossibility happens to touch being (see p. 234).

regions.text: 三角形を以て必然性と可能性とに共通の實在性を表はすならば偶然性は三角形の頂の一點に現實として立ちながら同時に無の線上に位置するものである三三六買多照。

quote.translation: If we represent by a triangle the reality that necessity and possibility share, contingency stands as the actual at the single point of the triangle's apex and is at the same time located on the line of nothingness (see p. 236).

regions.text: ある三三六買多照。必然性は有の彼域を

quote.translation: Necessity has completely occupied the domain of being.

regions.text: 必然性は有の彼域を完全に占めたものである。可能性は「可能的存在すなはち「生成可能性として有に面して立ち、偶然性は「反勤可能性」すなはち可能的非存在」として無に面して立つてろる。

quote.translation: Possibility stands facing being, as "possible existence", that is, as the "possibility of coming to be", whilst contingency stands facing nothingness, as the "possibility of the opposite", that is, as "possible non-existence".

regions.text: 理論に實踐に常に必然性を把持する考は無を自覺することが少ないであらう。

quote.translation: One who, in theory and in practice, always holds fast to necessity will seldom be conscious of nothingness.

regions.text: 可能性の追求にのみ心を砕く者は單に「鋏如として機念に無を

quote.translation: One who devotes himself solely to the pursuit of possibility will, in many cases, know nothingness conceptually, merely as "privation".
